blocks.html: A day trip or a two-day outing certainly has its charm, but multi-day tours are where the real magic lies. You still get all the excitement of discovering a new country, only now it is spread across several days – or a week, or two… or three… or even four.

blocks.orig: Adventure Awaits with Tanzania’s Multi-Day Tours
blocks.html: Multi-day tours in Tanzania: adventure is waiting

blocks.orig: What sets Tanzania multi-day tours apart from a single-day safari or a two-day outing? We’ve narrowed the benefits down to the following three.
blocks.html: How do Tanzania multi-day tours differ from a one-day safari or a two-day excursion? We have boiled the advantages down to these three.

blocks.orig: If you opt for Tanzania multi-day tours, you get the opportunity to fully immerse yourself in everything the country has to offer. From visiting the Maasai, to learning more about the flora and fauna during safaris and hiking in the mountains – tours spanning numerous days make your experience more complete.
blocks.html: Choosing a Tanzania multi-day tour gives you the chance to soak up all the country has to offer. Whether you are calling on the Maasai, discovering the plants and animals on safari or trekking in the mountains – a tour that stretches over many days makes the whole experience far more complete.

blocks.orig: During a multi-day tour with Your Tanzania Trip, we take care of the logistics and itinerary. That means you can spend more time exploring and tanning and less time planning.
blocks.html: On a multi-day tour with Your Tanzania Trip, the logistics and the itinerary are handled by us. The result: more time for exploring and sunbathing, less time spent organising.

blocks.orig: 3. Multi-day tours can be more cost-effective
blocks.html: 3. Multi-day tours can work out cheaper

blocks.orig: There’s no need to beat around the African bush: tours in Tanzania aren’t necessarily cheap, especially if you’re out and about for one or two days. A multi-day tour cuts your costs per day significantly. The reason: when you book a longer tour, the costs involved with flights, visa applications, etc., get divided over a greater number of days. Or in short: more value for money!
blocks.html: Let’s not beat around the African bush: a tour in Tanzania is not necessarily cheap, particularly when you are only away for a day or two. With a multi-day tour, the cost per day drops considerably. Why? Because once you book a longer tour, the expenses for flights, visa applications and so on are spread across many more days. In short: better value for your money!

blocks.orig: As with safaris and tours as a whole, there’s plenty to consider when booking multi-day tours in Tanzania – after all, there are so many options to choose from. We’ve taken the liberty of putting together some ideas for you.
blocks.html: Just as with safaris and tours in general, booking a multi-day tour in Tanzania involves plenty of decisions – there really is a huge range of options. To help you along, we have gathered a few ideas.

blocks.orig: Cultural tours: If you take a lot of interest in cultures and traditions from other countries, how about visiting the Maasai, spending the day with the Iraqw tribe or exploring the Kondoa rock paintings?
blocks.html: Cultural tours: If the cultures and traditions of other countries fascinate you, why not call on the Maasai, spend a day with the Iraqw tribe or go and see the Kondoa rock paintings?

blocks.orig: Adventure tours: From climbing Kilimanjaro to taking hot air balloon rides or exploring villages in Tuk-Tuks – with a multi-day tour, the thrill-seekers among you can easily create their adventurous potpourri.
blocks.html: Adventure tours: Whether it is climbing Kilimanjaro, going up in a hot air balloon or touring villages by Tuk-Tuk – a multi-day tour lets the adrenaline seekers among you put together their own adventurous mix.

blocks.orig: Safari tours: Whether it’s watching whales and dolphins, experiencing the Great Wildebeest Migration, or visiting a snake park – a good old safari is a must-do for many. No matter if on a horse, in a car or on foot.
blocks.html: Safari tours: From spotting whales and dolphins to witnessing the Great Wildebeest Migration or dropping in at a snake park – for many travellers a classic safari is simply essential. On horseback, by car or on foot, it is up to you.

blocks.orig: Family tours: If you want to experience Tanzania with your whole family, a multi-day tour will surely make everyone smile. Visit the Big Five during a safari, marvel at lush forests or simply build sandcastles on the pristine beaches of Zanzibar.
blocks.html: Family tours: Would you like to discover Tanzania together with the whole family? A multi-day tour is bound to put a smile on every face. Look for the Big Five on safari, admire the green forests or just build sandcastles on the unspoilt beaches of Zanzibar.

blocks.orig: Private tours: If you like the idea of going on a tour but don’t particularly want to spend time with a group of strangers, consider booking a private tour. This way, it’s just about you and your wishes… sometimes it’s absolutely okay to be a little selfish. 😉
blocks.html: Private tours: Keen on a tour, but not so keen on sharing it with a group of people you have never met? Then think about booking a private tour. That way everything revolves around you and your wishes… now and then a little selfishness is perfectly fine. 😉
